title: Overlap equality for framed graded line fractions
statement: Let $S,T$ be schemes, $h:T\to S$ a morphism, $A$ affine-basis quasi-coherent graded $\mathcal O_S$-algebra data, $L$ an $\mathcal O_T$-module, and $\psi$ a relative graded line map from $A$ to the tensor powers of $L$ over $h$ [def-trf-relative-graded-line-map]. For every open $W\subset T$, section $l\in\Gamma(W,L)$, and integer $n\ge0$, supply $P(l,n)\in\Gamma(W,L^{\otimes n})$ with $P(l,0)=1$ and $P(l,n+1)=l\otimes P(l,n)$. Let $c$ be a coefficient family such that $c_{U,W,l}(a)P(l,n)=\psi_U(a)|_W$ whenever $l$ is a free generator. Use the chart indices, source maps $s_i$, and maps $t_i$ of [def-trf-graded-line-fraction-chart]. Suppose each ring map $\rho_i$ satisfies the fraction formula there. Then for every two indices $i,j$ the maps $t_i,t_j$ agree on $X_i\times_T X_j$: $t_i\circ\mathrm{pr}_1=t_j\circ\mathrm{pr}_2$. No generation hypothesis, invertibility of $L$ outside the displayed framed opens, domain hypothesis on rings, or separation hypothesis on schemes is required.

proof.text: Apply the local base-refinement theorem separately to the two chart projections and V. It supplies restricted charts with precisely the same base V, original restricted frames and denominators, plus comparison morphisms on neighborhoods. Intersect the inverse images of these neighborhoods in the original source pullback.

proof.text: The two new comparison morphisms have the same composite to T, by their source equations and the original pullback condition. Use pullback.lift to map their common neighborhood into the pullback of the two restricted charts. Their bases are equal by construction, so apply the same-base overlap theorem and pull back its equality. The target comparison equations identify this equality with the restriction of the required equality.

theorem gradedLineFraction_overlap
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} {h : T ⟶ S} {A : S.GradedAlgebraData} {L : T.Modules}
    (ψ : RelativeGradedLineMap h A L)
    (P : ∀ {W : T.Opens}, Γ(L, W) → (n : ℕ) → Γ(L.tensorPow n, W))
    (hP0 : ∀ (W : T.Opens) (l : Γ(L, W)), P l 0 = unitSectionsEquiv W 1)
    (hPs : ∀ (W : T.Opens) (l : Γ(L, W)) (n : ℕ),
      P l (n + 1) = tmulSection l (P l n))
    (c : GradedLineFractionCoefficients h A L)
    (hc : ∀ (U : S.affineOpens) (W : T.affineOpens) (hWU : W.1 ≤ h ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)
      (l : Γ(L, W.1)), IsFreeGenerator l → ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : A.grading U n),
      c U W hWU l n a • P l n =
        (L.tensorPow n).val.map (homOfLE hWU).op (ψ.component U n a))
    (ρ : ∀ i : GradedLineFractionChart h A L,
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away (A.grading i.U) i.e.val →+*
        Localization.Away (i.coefficient c))
    (hρ : GradedLineFractionChart.FractionFormula c ρ) :
    ∀ i j : GradedLineFractionChart h A L,
      pullback.fst (i.source c) (j.source c) ≫ i.target c ρ =
        pullback.snd (i.source c) (j.source c) ≫ j.target c ρ
